title: As U.S. graduate financing changes, affordability by design matters more
content:
As federal borrowing rules change, graduate education has a chance to move beyond sticker price and focus on flexibility, transparency, and long term value. For students, the question is not only how to pay for a degree, but whether the degree is designed to be worth the investment.

The post As U.S. graduate financing changes, affordability by design matters more appeared first on Coursera Blog.
